identity_system.name_status_zh: 方案暂定名，非官方规划名称
identity_system.mark_logic: A continuous railway line, three key-area nodes, and two clearly separated public and operations entrances. No third-party logo or font asset is used.
identity_system.usage_rule_zh: 主标题使用中英文全称；C、H、W仅作为专业图例简写，不作为对外名称。

public_space_components.function_zh: 分别标出公共服务入口与研发和设备运维入口，并显示同一事项编号和状态
public_space_components.function_en: Mark the public service and research and equipment operations entrances separately while showing one task reference and status

public_space_components.function_zh: 解释事项、受理申诉、完成转介并提供纸面办理
public_space_components.function_en: Explain requests, receive appeals, make referrals, and provide paper service

public_space_components.function_zh: 仅关闭研发与设备运维区，公共服务入口和有人值守服务区继续开放
public_space_components.function_en: Close the research and equipment operations area while keeping public service and the staffed service area open

public_space_components.function_zh: 提供连续休息、轮椅并坐和非消费停留
public_space_components.function_en: Provide frequent rest, wheelchair companion seating, and non-purchase stay

public_space_components.function_zh: 保留非手机路线、服务说明和申诉信息
public_space_components.function_en: Keep non-phone routes, service notes, and appeal information

public_space_components.function_zh: 让维护、物流和退役避开公众入口
public_space_components.function_en: Keep maintenance, logistics, and retirement away from public entry

public_space_components.title_zh: 资料版本与更新公示栏
public_space_components.function_zh: 公示资料来源、更新时间、暂停使用和更正记录
public_space_components.function_en: Publish information sources, update dates, pauses, and corrections

honor_display_nodes.display_rule_zh: 公布服务事项、责任岗位、开放时间和申诉方式，不做企业排名
honor_display_nodes.display_rule_en: Publish the service, accountable role, opening hours, and appeal route; do not rank firms

honor_display_nodes.display_rule_zh: 展示有来源的成果、失败记录和更正，不把宣传材料当作贡献证明
honor_display_nodes.display_rule_en: Show sourced work, failure records, and corrections; promotional material is not proof of contribution

honor_display_nodes.display_rule_zh: 标明研发与设备运维区正在运行、暂停或撤场，并说明公共服务是否继续
honor_display_nodes.display_rule_en: State whether research and equipment operations are open, paused, or being removed, and whether public service continues

event_and_community.developer_community_zh: 维护组件版本、测试协议、许可证和失败记录的开放工作组
event_and_community.developer_community_en: An open working group maintaining component versions, test protocols, licences, and failure records
event_and_community.international_outreach_zh: 以双语导览、项目证据卡和公开复盘为基础的国际交流专场；没有清权内容、具名主办方和活动许可时不举办
event_and_community.international_outreach_en: An international exchange session based on bilingual guidance, project evidence cards, and public review; it does not proceed without cleared content, a named host, and event approval
public_route_en: AI Origin technology transfer service point

evidence_activation_cycle: W侧封闭测试及人工签字
H侧向公众解释并接受异议
公共服务与研发与设备运维双入口核查及停止演练
取得权利、预算和责任证据后有限启用
年度复核，不合格则关闭W并保留公共服务入口—有人值守服务区
